name: aigpu-b1
description: Pre-silicon target architecture profile: AI-GPU B1 64-core datacenter AI-only chiplet/SoC class (Blackwell B200/B100 architectural class, graphics disabled; NOT measured physical silicon).

sources.evidence_status: PRE-SILICON TARGET ARCHITECTURE PROFILE ONLY: not measured physical silicon, not physical FPGA hardware, and not full-chip RTL sign-off. Modeled parameters are architectural targets derived for analytical comparison and SimX-scale studies; no cycle-calibrated latency or physical PPA claims are made.
sources.xlen: 64-bit RV64IMAFD compute architecture (48-bit device memory address space); configure --profile=aigpu-b1 selects build64 and build32 rejects the profile.
sources.NUM_CLUSTERS, NUM_CORES: 4 clusters x 16 cores per cluster = 64 cores total (multi-chiplet / multi-cluster datacenter AI-only SoC architectural target per ADR-006).
sources.NUM_WARPS, NUM_THREADS, ISSUE_WIDTH, FET: 32 warps x 32 threads per core with 4-wide warp-slice issue and 4-wide fetch (Blackwell-class datacenter SM-equivalent core configuration).
sources.NUM_ALU_LANES, NUM_FPU_LANES, NUM_LSU_LA: 32 ALU and 32 FP32 FPU lanes per processing block (8192 total FP32 lanes across 64 cores x 4 issue blocks x 32 lanes) paired with 8 LSU lanes per block.
sources.DCACHE_SIZE, DCACHE_MSHR_SIZE, DCACHE_NU: 128 KiB L1 D-cache per core (131072 B, 4 ways, 64 B lines, 4 banks => 128 sets/bank), 24 MSHR entries per bank.
sources.LMEM_ENABLE, LMEM_LOG_SIZE, LMEM_SIZE, L: 128 KiB local shared memory per core (131072 B, LMEM_LOG_SIZE=17 <= 18 WGMMA smem descriptor limit) across 16 8-byte banks (128 B/cycle conflict-free bank bandwidth).
sources.VM_ENABLE, EXT_A_ENABLE, EXT_ZACAS_ENABL: Virtual memory (SV39), RV64A atomics + Zacas compare-and-swap, Zfhmin half-precision loads/conversions, 16-lane MUFU transcendental unit (divisible into 32 SFU lanes), and 16 hardware barriers.
sources.EXT_TCU_ENABLE, TCU_TYPE, TCU_PE_RATIO,: Native TFR tensor cores and STD scalar FPU (zero DPI substitution) with WGMMA warpgroup MMA, FP16/BF16, TF32, FP8/BF8, MX microscaling, MXFP4, NVFP4, INT8, and 2:4 structured sparsity enabled; TCU_PE_RATIO=2 (16 PEs of 4-word FEDP = 64 32-bit FMA terms/cycle per TCU block).
sources.EXT_DXA_ENABLE: Cluster-level async tensor DMA copy/multicast engine (TMA-class DXA) enabled.
sources.EXT_TEX_ENABLE, EXT_RASTER_ENABLE, EXT_O: Explicitly false: AI-only datacenter pruning removes texture, raster, output-merger, and ray-tracing graphics hardware to maximize AI compute/area efficiency.
sources.L2_ENABLE, L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS, L2_NUM_: 64 MiB L2 cache (67108864 B, 16 ways, 64 banks, 128 B sectored lines => 512 sets/bank), 192 MSHRs/bank.
sources.PLATFORM_CLOCK_RATE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_PEA: Pre-silicon architectural target: modeled 2000 MHz core clock and HBM3E-class 4,000 GB/s (4000000 MB/s) bandwidth modeled on Vortex's JEDEC HBM3 timing standard (only HBM2/HBM3/GDDR6 exist in VX_config.toml) across 64 power-of-two 128-bit channels at 3906 MT/s (64 x 16 B x 3906 MT/s = 3999.7 GB/s).
sources.reference: Modeled analytical pre-silicon target figures (fp32_lanes=8192, dram_bandwidth_gbs=4000, dram_peak_bytes_per_cycle=2000, clock_mhz=2000) checked by ci/profile_check.py --metrics=peak. Explicitly NOT physical silicon measurements or calibrated latency targets.
